内置官方轨道，超出有效期不外推。太阳位置按天文历表计算；地球为平均半径球体。整站: Bundled official ephemerides are not extrapolated beyond their validity. Solar position uses astronomical ephemerides; Earth is a mean-radius sphere. Station attitude assumes along-track flight with nadir pointing. Array angles are simulated, not telemetry. Independent Xuntian is a same-orbit illustration.
星点方向来自 J2000 星表，不随地球自转。摄影风格仅作曝光近似。云图为静态合: Star directions use a fixed J2000 catalogue. Photo style approximates exposure. Clouds are a static composite, not current weather. Ground tracks show approximately one orbit centered on the selected time.

各接口独立选择，可重复部署同型飞船；太阳翼按位置分别控制。自选组合可能产生几何重: Choose each port independently, including duplicate spacecraft. Arrays are controlled per instance. Custom assemblies may overlap.
自动按各实例转轴寻优；遮挡使用采样估计。转速暂设 3°/模拟秒，跳转时间直接重算: Optimize each instance within its rotation axes; estimate occlusion by sampling. Slew rate is 3° per simulated second. Time jumps recompute angles directly. Manual adjustment disables auto-tracking.
整组转动带动尾部转架及双翼；翼板自转只改变翼面朝向。角度为可视化演示，不代表实物: Assembly roll rotates the rear frame and both arrays; array pitch changes panel orientation. Angles are illustrative, not actual mechanical limits.
所有问天、梦天实例按对应转轴联动；反向轴使用相反角度，非平行轴不保证翼面平行。: All Wentian/Mengtian instances follow their corresponding axes. Reversed axes use opposite angles; nonparallel axes may not yield parallel panels.
翼板绕根部横向转轴旋转。此实例的角度可独立控制。: The array rotates about its transverse root axis. This instance can be controlled independently.
